project: CertaRig extended bench candidate procurement review

items.description: 12V two-wire brushless centrifugal pump. Listing: 9.5L/min, 6m, 18W; attached sheet: 9L/min, 5m, 1.38A/16.6W. B drawing uses G1/2 threaded ports; flooded suction required.
items.holds: Resolve sheet/listing revision, connector and permitted on/off switching, input inrush, supply shutdown/reverse-voltage limits. Do not substitute A or C housing.
items.pin_delivery: 400053 checked: Mumbai; estimates 13 Nov air / 16 Nov standard, 2026. Not a guarantee.

items.description: Direct-acting NC listing. Uflow DAS manufacturer family offers 12V DC 10W coils. Exact listing does not select a 12V coil.
items.holds: DO NOT ORDER yet: obtain exact 12V DC continuous-duty water-rated zero-differential part, port drawing, Kv, coil resistance/inductance/closing time. Title/part sizing needs reconciliation; family data is not proof for this order.

items.stock: Live UI: 0-1bar variant orderable; no explicit inventory
items.description: Two-wire SS304 wetted pressure transmitter. Web supply 10-28V; PDF 11-30V. Use intersection 11-28V. Accuracy conflict: 0.5%FS versus 0.5%reading; calculations use 0.5%FS.
items.holds: Obtain fixed variant/order code, gauge reference, factory calibration, pressure/overload rating, connector/pinout and stock/lead time. No contact sent.

items.description: G1/4 pulse turbine, advertised 0.3-6L/min. Supply text conflicts 3.5-12 versus 3.5-24V; choose 5V only after confirmation.
items.holds: Confirm actual make, flow direction, threads, output circuit/sink current and supply; use isolated 3.3V pulse interface and timed-volume calibration, never raw 5V into Pi.

items.stock: Listing: In Stock; ships from Mumbai
items.description: Stainless probe, 3.0-5.5V 1-Wire, advertised +/-0.5C at -10..85C. Power at 3.3V, separate 4.7k pull-up.
items.holds: Probe sealing and genuine IC not independently established; inspect/calibrate; cable colors must be measured rather than assumed.

items.description: 0.1ohm 1% 2W shunt, +/-3.2A, I2C, <=26V common mode. Separate addresses required.
items.holds: Old 4A threshold is outside measurement range. A 2.5A threshold is measurable but cannot replace independent fast protection; startup current unknown. Add separate load-voltage feedback.

items.description: Two DRV8871 bridges, 6.5-45V supply, 3.3V-compatible control. TI specifies 3.6A PEAK, not continuous.
items.holds: HOLD: confirm board RILIM values, thermal copper/heatsinking, connect/polarity and pump compatibility. Never reverse or PWM an unapproved two-wire BLDC. Auto-fault recovery needs external latch veto.

items.description: 3.3-5.5V buffered 120ohm receiver; 0-25mA becomes 0-3V; TP5551 amplifier on supplied schematic.
items.holds: Not a proven protected ADC interface: 33mA gives 3.96V at burden input; input short and Pi-off conditions require separate qualified protection. Comparison purchase only; not needed if custom receiver replaces it.
items.pin_delivery: 400053 checked: expected 12 Nov 2026; holiday dispatch warning up to 72h.

items.price_basis: INR excluding tax/duty; 18% tax used only as planning reserve
items.description: 36V loop protector; 27-33mA DC limit, 25ohm typical/45ohm max. 6-TDFN exposed pad.
items.holds: PCB/reflow required; not breadboard-ready. DC bound does not qualify fault overshoot. Import freight, GST/duty and assembly extra.

items.price_basis: INR excluding tax/duty; 18% tax used only as planning reserve
items.description: 4-channel SPST, up to 3.6V powered-off signal handling. UQFN package; bounded 4.5ohm simulation.
items.holds: TSSOP PWR alternative was out of stock at DigiKey; UQFN requires PCB/reflow. Power sequencing/PG/reference clamp still unselected.

items.description: 12V SPDT PCB relay, 360ohm/33mA coil; 10A headline is resistive. Two distinct cutoff paths contemplated.
items.holds: Actual DC inductive rating, PCB terminals, contact suppression and reset/watchdog implementation need design review; not a certified safety relay.

items.description: Red 40mm latching turn-release 1NC, 22mm mounting. Interrupt protected cutoff-coil supply, Pi remains powered.
items.holds: Verify N-suffix datasheet/DC contact rating, mechanical mounting and additional contact needs. Never use unknown old E-stop contact rating for new actuator power.

items.stock: Ships within 15 days; not ready local stock
items.description: Enclosed 12V 5A 60W desktop adapter. Exact output plug and mains cord need matching.
items.holds: 15-day lead time threatens checkpoint. Confirm BIS-labelled supplied unit, input cord, connector rating and current-limit/startup behavior. Nameplate does not prove pump startup compatibility.

items.description: External 24V 1A adapter, advertised short protection. Loop needs 11V minimum at transmitter plus burden/protector.
items.holds: BIS/SELV identity, regulation/ripple, polarity and terminal assembly not verified; preferred final supply must have traceable compliance. Never expose mains on bench.

items.description: 22mm compression automatic DIFFERENTIAL BYPASS; adjustable 0.05-0.5bar. Manufacturer sheet does not establish a certified safety relief valve.
items.holds: HOLD: flow capacity, set tolerance, back pressure, adapters and stock unresolved. Cannot use this listing to declare pressure protection accepted.

items.description: Published working 6bar, burst 18bar, 30m standard roll. Design needs about 5m, not necessarily sold cut.

items.description: 1L graduated PP cylinder, timed collection for flow calibration.
items.holds: 30-day lead time; graduation tolerance/certificate not specified. Seek local Class B equivalent and confirm error; do not claim traceable calibration by product title.

items.description: Non-mercury alcohol laboratory thermometer, -10..110C.
items.holds: No stated uncertainty/certificate in listing; comparative check only until reference error established. Lower-cost Ralco listing needs exact variant confirmation.

items.description: 412x301x73mm tray, nominal 7L.
